subject: design/wake-channel-v1
statement: When a drive stops on an awaited external completion it **registers the await before stopping**: the journal's closing entry for the touch names the awaited goal object and the completion condition (FR-13's authority — a resumed session re-derives the await from the journal alone), and the regenerated derived block surfaces one typed line per await inside its Open-items element — the grammar (fixed at implementation, closed per AP-6) carries the goal object, the condition, and the since-date that UB-9's ages read. An await clears when the resumed touch's reconciliation verifies the completion at the goal object; a cleared await simply leaves the regenerated block. This rides the ledger class **additively**: the derived block's contracted content list is untouched (Open items already exists; the journal stays the only authority — the artifacts design's DINV-6), and a first-class Awaits row is deferred to a future template version bump under that design's own successor-rule (§7 Q2).
